## Appearance

Diana Barry is a very pretty, vivacious little girl with a lively look. She has rosy cheeks, black eyes, and jet-black, glossy hair.

## Personality

Diana is characterized by her cheerful, good, and sweet nature, often bringing laughter and smiles to those around her through her merry words and ways. She also possesses a notable taste in dressing, making her advice on the subject highly sought after. Even in times of sorrow, her kind disposition remains a defining trait.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P9](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P19](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P21](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0021)_

## History

Diana Barry was named at birth by a visiting schoolmaster who was boarding with her family. As a young girl in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), she met [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and immediately swore a vow of eternal friendship with her in the Barrys' garden. Diana was briefly forced by her mother to bid [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a dramatic goodbye following an incident with wine, but their friendship was restored after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully saved the life of Diana's severely ill baby sister, [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md). Although Diana did not join Miss Stacy's advanced Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) class alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), she remained a close companion, bringing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) the pass list to reveal her tied first-place victory and helping her dress for a major recitation at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064), [v1 CHAPTER XII. ## Quotes

> "Gertie Pye actually went and put her milk bottle in my place in the brook yesterday. Did you ever? I don’t speak to her now."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)

> “I don’t believe he’ll find the doctor at Carmody,” sobbed Diana. “I know that Dr. Blair went to town and I guess Dr. Spencer would go too. Young Mary Joe never saw anybody with croup and Mrs. Lynde is away. Oh, Anne!”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P24](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0024)

> “Everything went off very well,” said Diana practically. “I guess we must have made as much as ten dollars. Mind you, Mr. Allan is going to send an account of it to the Charlottetown papers.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P49](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0049)

> "Why, he makes fun of all the girls. He laughs at mine because it’s so black. He’s called me a crow a dozen times; and I never heard him apologize for anything before, either."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P53](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0053)

> "I do think you’re mean. What shall I do? Mr. Phillips will make me sit with that horrid Gertie Pye—I know he will because she is sitting alone. Do come back, Anne."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P74](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0074)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

Diana and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) became devoted friends and playmates immediately upon meeting, even swearing a vow of eternal friendship in the Barrys' garden. They frequently walk to school together, share confidences, and support each other through dramatic schoolhouse events and family crisis, such as when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helped save Diana's sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md). Despite occasional temporary separations imposed by adults, their bond remains exceptionally close and central to their daily lives.

- Comrade of — close friends and playmates  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P8](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0008)</sub>
